children: UTG's revenue fell 14.3% and earnings declined year over year, as total revenue was primarily affected by lower net investment gains; gains from changes in equity-security fair values were $8.7 million versus $10.7 million a year earlier. Net investment income increased to $4.9 million from $4.0 million.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to common shareholders”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per share”.
: Net investment income rose to $4.9 million from $4.0 million, with mortgage-loan and real-estate income contributing to the increase.
: The quarter's fair-value gain on equity securities was $8.7 million, compared with $10.7 million in 2025.
: Third-quarter benefits and other expenses were approximately $6.1 million, compared with $5.3 million a year earlier.
: A land sale agreement could generate an approximately $18 million realized gain, or $14.2 million in after-tax net income, if completed; closing is not assured.
